name: Rowan & Hound Supply Co.
founderStory: Founded in 2018 by veterinary technicians and pet companions frustrated by industrial bulk pet food warehousing. Rowan & Hound partners directly with family ranches in the Pacific Northwest to roast nutrient-dense single-protein dry kibble, simmer hydration-rich bone broths, and cure whole milk yak chews in small 800-lb kettle batches every three weeks.
mission: To nourish companion animals with clean, biologically appropriate ingredients while making routine replenishment practical, trustworthy, and stress-free.

values.title: Fresh-Batch Roasting
values.description: Baking dry foods every 21 days so essential fatty acids and probiotics never degrade on warm warehouse shelves.

values.title: Transparent Single-Source Proteins
values.description: Pasture-grazed venison, line-caught Alaskan sockeye, and cage-free heritage turkey with zero mystery meat meals.

values.title: Zero Rawhide Policy
values.description: 100% natural yak cheese and sun-cured marrow bones, free from chemical bleach, glue, or formaldehyde.

values.title: No-Trap Subscriptions
values.description: Recurring auto-ship with guaranteed 10% savings, full flexibility to skip or pause in one click, and zero lock-in.
